# powerdns_recursor_zone (Data Source)

Reads a zone the Recursor holds.

Useful for a zone somebody else configured — an upstream forwarder set by another team, whose target this configuration needs to know.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A forwarder somebody else configured, whose target this configuration needs
# to know.
data "powerdns_recursor_zone" "corp" {
  name = "corp.example."
}

output "forwarders" {
  # Reported with the port the Recursor defaulted: 192.0.2.53 reads back as
  # 192.0.2.53:53.
  value = data.powerdns_recursor_zone.corp.servers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The zone to read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The canonical zone name.
- `kind` (String) `Native` or `Forwarded`.
- `notify_allowed` (Boolean) Whether NOTIFY is accepted for this zone.
- `recursion_desired` (Boolean) Whether forwarded queries carry the RD bit.
- `servers` (List of String) Upstreams, for a `Forwarded` zone. The Recursor reports these with the port it defaulted, so an address given as `192.0.2.53` reads back as `192.0.2.53:53`.
